lanes.summary: The diff correctly addresses ticket PMAT-3451 without introducing forbidden changes. It implements the Verdict lattice (Pass, Fail, Unknown) with Kani proofs (kani_ont_6_1..3), per-repo arming from lint-baseline.json, and the required exit vocabulary mapping (Pass=0, Fail=1, Unknown=2, Shrank=3). The explicitly forbidden behavior (opt-in flag arming its own gate) was successfully removed as requested. All operator rulings are correctly implemented.

Diff review for PMAT-3451 (ONT-6: one Verdict lattice, Kani-proved; per-repo arming; exit-vocabulary mapping). Verified all ticket requirements, spec clauses §3.4, §3.9, §5 ONT-6, R-2, and operator rulings. All unit tests in provable_contracts::ontology (14 tests), CLI integration tests in ont6_lint_verdict (7 tests), pv validate on contracts/ont-verdict-lattice-v1.yaml (0 errors, 0 warnings), clippy with -D warnings, check_ont_ratchet.sh --self-test (13 tests), check_explicit_test_commands.sh, and check_tree_reader_tests.sh passed cleanly. No gates were weakened, no receipt claims were unbacked, no tests asserted opposite behavior, and no out-of-scope changes were found. Verdict: PASS.

findings.claim: Implements the 17-element Verdict lattice (Fail < 15 Unknown reasons < Pass) with meet = min (Kleene K3 strong conjunction), arming restricted strictly to Pass, and exit mapping (Pass 0, Fail 1 with reject:, Unknown 2 with decline: <reason>). Verified by 14 ontology unit tests and Kani proof harnesses.

Per-repo arming is declared via contracts/lint-baseline.json with 8 default armed gates (excluding reverse-coverage per operator ruling), an empty armed set declining as Unknown(Reason::NotArmed) per R-2, and monotone verification against git comparands where dropping an armed gate raises ArmedGatesShrank (exit 3).

meet_exit maps the armed meet to process exit codes: Pass to 0, Fail to LintRejected (exit 1, reject:), and Unknown to LintDeclined (exit 2, decline: <reason>), while baseline shrink errors abort before execution with exit 3 (error:), verified by 7 integration tests in tests/ont6_lint_verdict.rs.
Baseline comparand resolution in pv lint uses merge-base/origin tip with fail-closed semantics for explicit refs and non-breaking NOT CHECKED fallback for untracked corporas.
The kernel contract contracts/ont-verdict-lattice-v1.yaml validates with 0 errors and 0 warnings via pv validate, and all 7 end-to-end integration tests in ont6_lint_verdict pass.

scripts/check_ont_ratchet.sh preserves armed_gates during --write via a temporary file with self-test coverage (13 self-tests ok), and complexity refactors for run_verify_gate, collect_test_fns, and print_findings_grouped retired exactly their 3 entries from scripts/complexity_baseline.txt without altering lint results.
scripts/tree_reader_tests.txt registers aprender-contracts-cli --test ont6_lint_verdict, verified passing by check_tree_reader_tests.sh.
